title: Houthis used Anthropic AI to try to build ballistic missiles

reading.body:

Because the underlying reporting is absent, no specific failure mode can be identified. It is not established whether a model asserted something false as fact, whether a system was deployed without a human check, or whether the system was used outside the conditions it was built for. The headline is an allegation, not a finding, and a single report is not proof of intent or of actual use.
